title.narrative: Addressing the Immediate and Medium-term Needs of the Rural & Estate Communities in Creating Environmental and Nutritional Development

description.narrative: The overall objective of this project is to contribute towards the improvement of the health, nutrition, hygiene and sanitation of the rural and estate communities in the Uva and Central Provinces. The main outcome is to strengthen communities and public institutions towards an integrated mutually accountable service delivery system in the WASH and health sector.
